title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon Set for Racing Fireworks in 2026
claims: The 2026 edition takes place on Sunday 24 May with 27,000 marathon runners; around 32% are running the event for the first time.

The field includes 8,500 international participants from 145 countries, with 1,571 from the United States, 712 from the United Kingdom and 358 from Germany; the leading African countries are Zimbabwe (263), Botswana (177) and Kenya (133).
The event hosts 1,800 AbbottWMM Marathon Tours & Travel Age Group World Championship runners.
A further 17,500 participants take part in the 10 km and 5 km Peace Runs and the 43 km, 22 km and 11 km trail runs on Saturday 23 May, for a weekend total of 44,500 athletes.
The elite field includes seven World Athletics Platinum Label and 13 Gold Label athletes.

Sunday's marathon starts with the Peace Flame Ceremony at 07:20, the wheelchair race at 07:50 and the elite start at 08:00 in Fritz Sonnenberg Road; the Age Group World Championship wave starts on Beach Road at 08:05.
The rest of the marathon field starts in five waves, three in Fritz Sonnenberg Road and two in Beach Road, from 08:10 to 09:06.
The event sets up five emergency misting zones if high temperatures are expected.
The 2026 infrastructure includes 205 toilets on the route, 600 marshals, 13.5 km of fencing and 7,200 traffic cones.
